S, THIS  DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
 CORAM: THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SHIVASHANKAR AMARANNAVAR  -2-  NC: 2025:KHC-D:4569  CRL.P No. 100614 of 2024  ORAL ORDER
Learned counsel for the petitioner files a memo seeking withdrawal of the petition with liberty to file a fresh petition.

2. Memo reads thus;
"Herein, the Advocate for petitioner most humbly Submits as under.
That, in the top noted matter, the Respondent have completed the investigation and filed charge-sheet.
Therefore, the petitioner intends to withdraw the petition with an intention to challenge the charge sheet, if necessary.
Hence the petition may be dismissed as withdrawn with a liberty to file fresh petition in the interest of justice.
Hence this memo."
3. In view of the memo, the petition is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as prayed for.

4. Registry is directed to return all the documents to learned counsel for the petitioner.
Sd/-
(SHIVASHANKAR AMARANNAVAR) JUDGE PJ/CT-ASC Suhas Rathod S/O Shivanna Rathod vs The State Of Karnataka on 11 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/57450587/
